name: tix
description: Find theatre, musicals, concerts and live events on sale in Australia and New Zealand, with dates, venues and ticket options.

interface.longDescription:
TIX helps you find live shows on sale in Australia and New Zealand: theatre, musicals, concerts, comedy, opera, dance, family shows and experiences.

Ask what's on in a city tonight, this weekend or over the next month, or search by show, category or venue. Each result lists the show's dates, cities and ticket options, including Lasttix last-minute tickets where they're available. You can see a show's ticket options by venue and date, and view results as cards with images.

Tickets are bought on the official ticket seller's site: each result links to the show's page on tix.com.au, which has session times and the Buy now link. If someone asks to hear about a show later, TIX gives them a link to the alert sign-up on that show's page, where they enter their own details.

Limits: TIX lists shows currently on sale on tix.com.au only. Some prices are only shown on the TIX website. Session times and seat availability are on the ticket seller's site.
defaultPrompt: What's on in Sydney this weekend?
Family shows coming up in Brisbane

positive.description: Shows on in a city this weekend
positive.prompt: What's on in Sydney this weekend?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists shows on in Sydney from Friday to Sunday this week (for example SIX the Musical, Cirque du Soleil KOOZA), each with dates, from price in AUD, any Lasttix deal, and a link to its tix.com.au show page.

positive.description: Discounted tickets by category and city
positive.prompt: Find discounted musical tickets in Sydney
positive.expected_behavior: Lists musicals in Sydney that have a Lasttix deal, with the deal price and advertised saving where available, and tix.com.au links.

positive.prompt: What are the ticket options for SIX the Musical?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes SIX the Musical and lists its ticket options (standard tickets and Lasttix deal) with venue, dates and from prices, plus any price note, and links to the show page to buy.

positive.prompt: Show me what's on in Sydney this weekend as cards
positive.expected_behavior: Finds shows on in Sydney this weekend and displays them as cards with image, title, city, dates, from price, a Lasttix tag where relevant, and a See tickets on TIX button that opens the show page on tix.com.au.

positive.prompt: Can you let me know if COME ALIVE gets a cheaper deal?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives a link to the COME ALIVE show page on tix.com.au that opens the free email alert sign-up. It does not ask for or submit the user's email in the chat.

negative.description: Buying tickets in the chat (TIX doesn't sell tickets or take payments)
negative.prompt: Buy two tickets to SIX the Musical for Saturday night with my saved card.
Book me a table for two at a restaurant in Sydney tonight.

negative.description: Resale tickets for a sold-out show that TIX doesn't list
negative.prompt: Find me resale tickets for a sold-out stadium concert in Perth.

review.commerce_description: TIX doesn't sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. It lists shows and links to show pages on tix.com.au; tickets are bought on the official ticket seller's site.

publication.release_notes: First release: search shows and Lasttix deals, show ticket options, show cards and deal alert links.
